packages.name: iBoot32Patcher
packages.checksum_source: SHA-256 calculated from this GitHub archive on 2026-09-28. LukeZGD's fork (the one Legacy-iOS-Kit ships), master of 2026-09-14. firmwarekit runs it as a separate process (K48IBoot.patchIBoot) for the k48 iboot recipe. Built with build-support/patches/iBoot32Patcher-ltm.patch (uint16_t/uint32_t Thumb bit-fields in arm32_defs.h so GCC/MinGW match Clang on iOS 5-7 RSA patching, word-aligned xref matches only, smoke #48/#50); K48IBootTests checks its output byte-for-byte against the Legacy-iOS-Kit v25.09.01 binary on every k48 build that binary patches.
